title: Measures for Ethics Review and Services for Artificial Intelligence Science and Technology (Trial)
title_original: 人工智能科技伦理审查与服务办法（试行）
summary: AI-specific trial ethics measures (MIIT Lianke [2026] No. 75), dated 20 March 2026. They were issued by MIIT with NDRC, the Ministries of Education, Science and Technology, and Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the National Health Commission, the People's Bank of China, the CAC, the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the China Association for Science and Technology. They set ethics review procedures for AI research and development and an ethics service system for risk monitoring, testing, certification and consulting. Expert re-review applies to human-machine fusion systems that strongly affect behaviour, emotions or health, to public-opinion-mobilising algorithms and to highly autonomous automated decision systems. MIIT began a pilot programme in May 2026.
key_obligations: Put AI research and development with ethical risks through ethics review
Get expert re-review for human-machine fusion systems affecting behaviour, emotion or health
Get expert re-review for public-opinion algorithms and highly autonomous decision systems
